title: 第21章 龙骑士第22章 为了你 暗爪
lines: 冰冷，比归墟最深处的黑暗更刺骨，从卡拉斯左肋下方蔓延。
蛛网般的灰黑色裂痕如同活物，吮吸着秩序之力，将刺痛化为跗骨之蛆，啃噬他残存的意识。
他像一尊破碎的玉像，嵌在“破浪号”
船头破裂的甲板里，视野模糊摇晃。
船体在脚下发出垂死的呻吟。
左臂内侧那道淡金色旧伤的灼热感…变了。
不再是纯粹的剧痛。
而是一种清晰的、如同微弱心跳般的脉动。
一下，又一下。
微弱如风中残烛，却带着一丝奇异的暖意。
像在绝对零度的黑暗中，指尖触碰到微温的烛火。
暗爪…是它吗？在混沌的核心，它还守着最后一点光？
这念头如同投入死水的巨石，在他濒临冻结的意识中掀起巨浪。
他覆盖着象牙白色材质的双手猛地抠进甲板缝隙。
力量！
他需要力量！
一声混合剧痛与决绝的低吼从他喉部挤出。
他积攒着星辉之躯内部残存的秩序之光，猛地爆发！
包裹身体的碎裂木板应声崩开。
卡拉斯如同挣脱束缚的白色幽灵，从凹坑中弹射而起，双脚重重踏在摇晃的船头，身躯前倾如猎豹。
眼睛穿透暗红泡沫和幽绿余烬，死死锁定漩涡中心那片黑暗深渊。
暗爪就在那里。
“石头人！
你他妈还要干什么？！”
独眼船长嘶哑的咆哮从后方传来，带着惊恐与绝望。
水手们瘫倒在甲板上，脸上只剩劫后余生的茫然和更深恐惧。
那条被轰碎的恐怖巨臂，残留的断口还在海面翻滚，喷洒粘稠污血。
卡拉斯没有回头。
全部意识都凝聚在左臂内侧那道疯狂脉动、传递微弱暖意的淡金色伤痕上。
归墟入口就在眼前。
暗爪的呼唤就在耳边。
他覆盖着象牙白色材质的双手缓缓张开，重心下沉，仿佛要将自己钉在这破船船头。
“破浪号”
如同被无形巨手推搡，船头深深扎入巨大漩涡边缘。
粘稠如血的暗红海水疯狂拍打船体。
船身发出凄厉呻吟，仿佛即将解体。
漩涡中心的黑暗散发出致命吸力，要将一切拖入永恒湮灭。
就在这时——
一声宏大威严的神圣龙吟，如同万钧雷霆，撕裂归墟上空的混沌阴云。
声音中蕴含的纯粹秩序之力，如同阳光刺破永夜，驱散腥臭与硫磺。
一道庞大到难以想象、覆盖温暖神圣金色鳞片的身影，如同撕裂空间的太阳神只，骤然出现在“破浪号”
上空。
金龙阿斯特拉！
它那双熔金湖泊般的巨大竖瞳，穿透海水与能量乱流，精准锁定漩涡中心那片最深沉的黑暗，也锁定了黑暗核心处那个散发微弱秩序共鸣的白色身影。
content_en:
Coldness, more biting than the darkness in the deepest part of Guixu, spread from the bottom of Karas's left ribs.
The spiderweb-like gray-black cracks were like living things, sucking the power of order, turning the sting into maggots on the tarsus, gnawing at his remaining consciousness.
He is like a broken jade statue embedded in the "Broken Wave"
In the cracked deck of the ship's bow, the vision was blurry and shaking.
The hull groaned dyingly beneath its feet.
The burning sensation of the old pale golden wound on the inner side of his left arm... changed.
No longer pure excruciating pain.
But a clear pulse like a weak heartbeat.
Once, and again.
It was as weak as a candle in the wind, but it carried a strange warmth.
It's like touching the lukewarm candlelight with your fingertips in absolute zero darkness.
Dark Claw...is that it? In the core of chaos, is it still guarding the last bit of light?
This thought was like a boulder thrown into stagnant water, setting off huge waves in his consciousness that was on the verge of freezing.
His hands covered with ivory-white material dug into the gaps in the deck.
strength!
He needs strength!
A low roar mixed with severe pain and determination was squeezed out of his throat.
He accumulated the remaining light of Symbol inside the star body and exploded suddenly!
The splintered wooden boards wrapping the body collapsed with a sound.
Like a white ghost that broke free from restraints, Karas ejected from the pit, his feet heavily placed on the rocking bow of the ship, and his body leaned forward like a cheetah.
His eyes penetrated the dark red foam and green embers, and locked onto the dark abyss at the center of the vortex.
Darkclaw is there.
"Stone man!
What the hell are you going to do? ! "
The hoarse roar of the one-eyed captain came from behind, filled with fear and despair.
The sailors collapsed on the deck, with only the confusion and deeper fear of the rest of their lives on their faces.
The remaining fractures of the terrifying giant arm that had been shattered were still rolling on the sea surface, spraying sticky blood.
Karas didn't look back.
All his consciousness was concentrated on the pale golden scar on the inner side of his left arm that pulsed crazily and conveyed a faint warmth.
The entrance to Guixu is right in front of you.
Darkclaw's call is in my ears.
His hands covered with ivory-white material slowly opened, and his center of gravity sank, as if he wanted to nail himself to the bow of the broken ship.
"The Wavebreaker"
As if being pushed by an invisible giant hand, the bow of the ship plunged deeply into the edge of the huge whirlpool.
Dark red water as thick as blood lapped at the hull of the ship crazily.
The ship's hull groaned shrilly, as if it was about to disintegrate.
The darkness at the center of the vortex exudes a fatal suction force that will drag everything into eternal annihilation.
Just then——
A majestic and majestic sacred dragon roar, like a thunderous thunder, tore apart the chaotic clouds above Guixu.
The pure power of order contained in the sound is like sunlight piercing the eternal night, dispelling the stench and sulfur.
An unimaginably huge figure covered in warm sacred golden scales, like a sun god tearing apart space, suddenly appeared on the "Breaker"
above.
Golden Dragon Astra!
Its huge vertical pupils, like molten gold lakes, penetrated the sea water and energy turbulence, accurately locked on the deepest darkness in the center of the vortex, and also locked on the white figure that exuded a weak resonance of order at the core of the darkness.
title_en: Chapter 21 Dragon Knight Chapter 22 For You Dark Claw
